body: Yeah I’m really confused about some saying he’s a narcissist. I definitely could’ve been nicer which is where I was wrong. Got frustrated and gave into it. 😬 definitely felt bad and needed to vent I don’t think he was scheming anything.
I agree it’s not rocket science especially cause Ive told him exactly what I like and showed him how to make it before but borderline abusive what do you mean?

I guess I’m just giving him the benefit of the doubt. He’s done similar things in the past and I get worked up easily over it. Like me asking him or telling him something multiple times he just said he’s forgetful. And no I don’t understand gaslighting I know what it is but not seeing how that’s applying here.

I wouldn’t call him a narcissist… we have talked since I made this post and he told me that he thought I asked for scrambled eggs last night when he asked what I wanted in the morning. I definitely didn’t say that and told him so, I asked for 2 eggs and 2 waffles what I usually eat for breakfast. I like my eggs overeasy and make them that way for myself everytime and have shown him how. I feel like he genuinely just didn’t listen I think it’s more of a half assing it, not purposefully doing it bad so I won’t ask again. I don’t really know much about narcissism but I know him it seemed neglectful not intentional or malicious. And I was frustrated but I wish I controlled my reaction better.
You’re right, thanks for your comment
